fusions.name: Passed Down the Line
fusions.desc: Throws a link that deals 7 damage, then leaps to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles for 50% of that. You heal for 12% of all damage dealt. Usable only on an enemy carrying one of your afflictions, and uses one of them up.

fusions.name: Hauled In
fusions.desc: Hauls you up to 6 tiles to the target for 12 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach. It moves 25% slower for 3 seconds, and you heal for 15% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Linked Repast
fusions.desc: Restores 2 health a second to you and every ally for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: One Good Turn
fusions.desc: Each time you gain health, a bolt passes along to the nearest enemy within 7 tiles for 6 lightning damage. Once every 3 seconds.
